correctness.rationale: The object is defined by an explicit 24-vertex coordinate graph. The verifier reconstructs its 36 edges and diameter 6. Complete acyclic matchings prove the scale-2 and scale-3 wedge types. At scale 4 it reconstructs 17,372 simplices and all 93,480 Hasse covers, verifies 8,682 matched pairs and global acyclicity, leaves critical cells in dimensions 0, 4, 5 with counts 1, 5, 2, and computes the exact integral Morse boundary from dimension 5 to 4 as zero. Hurewicz then makes both 5-cell attaching maps null. Scale 5 is checked to have exactly twelve antipodal nonedges, giving the boundary of a 12-dimensional cross-polytope, and scale 6 is a simplex.

value.rationale: This is a complete homotopy classification of the graph-metric Rips filtration of a canonical Archimedean solid explicitly suggested by the primary literature as a next family. It is not a parameter relabeling: the central scale exhibits a mixed-dimensional wedge with essential homology in adjacent dimensions, while the surrounding scales pass through two different 2-dimensional sphere stages and an 11-sphere. The exact filtration supplies a natural finite benchmark for how the Platonic-sphere pattern changes in the Archimedean setting.
